turns.text: Hello, yes, I would like to change my flight to Mumbai, please.
Happy to help with that. First I need to verify you, so may I have your booking code and last name?
Yes. The code is O, M, zero, N, five, P. Oh, em, zero, en, five, pee.
Thank you. I heard O, M, zero, N, five, P, and the last name please?
Iyer. I, Y, E, R. Iyer.
Thanks, Mr. Iyer, you're verified. Which change would you like to make on your Sunday Mumbai flight?
I want to go on Saturday instead, the evening one, if there is. Sorry, you said the code was M, N? I think you may have heard it as N, M.

No problem, the code I have matches what you gave, O, M, zero, N, five, P. For Saturday I'm afraid I only see the Sunday SK512 at 21:00 and the SK510 at 07:45, so I can't confirm a Saturday flight from here.
Oh. Then the Sunday morning one, the seven forty-five. Is that possible? And what is the cost?
Yes, SK510 at 07:45 is available. Your fare is Economy, so the change fee is $75, plus the fare difference, which is $210 for that flight against your current $190, so $20 more.
So seventy-five and twenty, ninety-five dollars total. Okay, that is acceptable. Please do it.
Done, I've moved you to SK510 on Sunday at 07:45 and the $95 will go on your card on file. To summarize, your booking OM0N5P is now on SK510, Sunday 07:45.
